About Salati & contact

What is Salati?

Salati is a website and Android app for prayer times, Quran reading and recitations, Qibla direction and daily remembrance. You can choose your city, calculation method and Asr convention, read the Quran and listen to available reciters. It is an independent service, not a government authority or an official publisher of mosque iqamah times.

Calculation and content sources

Prayer times use Salati’s engine and the Adhan library; the app can refresh calendars through AlAdhan. Quran text and recitation sources are identified in the Quran reader and privacy policy. City pages identify the timetable source and calculation convention. Coordinates, methods and local calendars can produce minute differences.
